facts.fact: The Media Foundation for West Africa reports Mauritanian authorities permanently shut down the news website Anbaa.info after its licence was revoked by the Ministry of Communication in July 2025 and its editor was summoned by the Cybercrime Unit on 25 August 2025 on a complaint from the regulator HAPA.

The Media Foundation for West Africa reports the news site Anbaa.info was closed for good in August 2025, after the Cybercrime Unit summoned its editor-in-chief, over analytical articles on Mauritania-Algeria relations published since 2022.
The Media Foundation for West Africa reports that in March 2024 the regulator HAPA sanctioned Anbaa.info for 'attacks against Algeria', making the site inaccessible for 60 days.

MRT.note: Nothing on consultation on digital law or policy.
